name: gif-maker-plugin-deps
description: Vendored runtime dependencies for the gif-maker plugin's decode support — see tools/codecs.js. Committed node_modules, not gitignored: the plugin installer copies this directory verbatim with no npm-install step, so the resolved dependency tree must already exist on disk for Node's module resolution to find it (same pattern as plugins/image-converter/package.json). png/jpg/webp decode are WASM codecs (@jsquash/*, repackaged Squoosh); bmp decode is pure JS; omggif is the pure-JS GIF encoder used for the combined animated output.
